title: Business Central v29: ModuleInfo Gets Four New Runtime 18 Values
summary: Business Central v29 introduces four new Runtime 18 fields on ModuleInfo (ContextSensitiveHelpUrl, EULA, Help, PrivacyStatement) that expose compliance and documentation metadata through AL code, eliminating the need to parse app.json or manifests.
key_points: Runtime 18 adds ContextSensitiveHelpUrl, EULA, Help and PrivacyStatement to the ModuleInfo data type
Values are read in AL after calling NavApp.GetCurrentModuleInfo, alongside existing Runtime 17 values such as Name, Id and AppVersion
Removes the need to look in app.json or manifests or duplicate this information in code
Useful for ISVs and AppSource apps to validate metadata at runtime, surface compliance info, and include documentation links in diagnostics or telemetry

quotes.text: With Runtime 18, we now get four new values that expose the module's compliance and documentation metadata directly through AL
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit: developers can access compliance information programmatically without parsing external files
